dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature on the trailing edge forming a falcate spline from the posterior ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex classification with an obtuse pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear anterior margin with a steepness of approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1 ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smoothly convex melon with a consistent arc radius visible on the dorsal-anterior cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Proportionally short and thick rostrum extending from the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly saturated cyan/teal pixel coloration across the entire body surface with high intensity highlights on the dorsal ridge.
